context7.description: Official Context7: documentation and API examples for external libraries; request the project's exact version. Public endpoint works without a key, with rate limits.

playwright.description: Official Playwright MCP: inspect and exercise web interfaces in a headless, isolated Chromium browser. No personal browser profile or saved credentials.

serena.description: Serena semantic code navigation and symbol-level refactoring for the current project. Memory, onboarding, shell and REPL are disabled; use Hindsight for past decisions.
